address: 115 Bukit Merah View Market & Hawker Centre, #01-28, Blk 115 Bukit Merah View, 151115, Singapore
bio: This stall specialises in halal char kway teow – flat rice noodles and egg noodles are tossed in herb-infused oil with eggs, bean sprouts, fish cake and cockles. The flavours and wok hei are truly amazing.
